SELECT 
    (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score <= (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements)) as q1,
    (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements) as median,
    (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score >= (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements)) as q3
FROM measurements LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements WHERE reaction_ms <= (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements)) as q1,
    (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements) as median,
    (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements WHERE reaction_ms >= (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements)) as q3
FROM measurements LIMIT 1;

    SELECT 
        (SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) FROM measurements WHERE cognitive_score <= (SELECT median FROM (SELECT MEDIAN(cognitive_score) as median FROM measurements))) as q1_cs,

        (SELECT MEDIAN(reaction_ms) FROM measurements) as median_rm,
        (SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) FROM measurements WHERE reaction_ms >= (SELECT median FROM (SELECT MEDIAN(reaction_ms) as median FROM measurements))) as q3_rm
)
SELECT * FROM quartile_stats;

       MAX(reaction_ms) as max_rm 
FROM cleaned_measurements;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cleaned_measurements;

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT 
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    condition,
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    recorded_at,
    status,
    notes
FROM measurements
WHERE cognitive_score >= 60  -- Above Q1 - significant outliers excluded
    AND reaction_ms <= 700;  -- Below upper quartile - extreme outliers excluded

SELECT COUNT(*) as record_count, 
       MIN(cognitive_score) as min_cs, 
       MAX(cognitive_score) as max_cs,
       MIN(reaction_ms) as min_rm, 
       MAX(reaction_ms) as max_rm 
FROM cleaned_measurements;
SELECT Psi AVG(cognitive_score) FROM cleaned_measurements;
